summary: Source-qualified backfill of a single linked Red Sea/Bab el-Mandeb shipping-control claim family: original September media assertions and recorded Reddit repost; July 30 fourteen-state Saudi-led maritime coalition declaration and subsequent official status; September coastal gains, October Saudi-backed Yemen counteroffensive and reported U.S. intelligence/European defensive support; November 12 JMIC open-transit and still-contested-control evidence. This source packet makes no knowing-deception inference, asserts no legal enforcement authority beyond official documents, and does not misstate social-platform origin or traffic metrics.

sources.title: Houthis control key shipping route after gains along Yemen’s Red Sea coast
sources.source_role: MEDIA_HEADLINE_CLAIM_CARRIER; September coastal control story, not proof of whole-sea control

sources.title: U.S. Maritime Advisory 2026-013: Houthi Attacks on Commercial Vessels
sources.source_role: PRIMARY_MARITIME_GUIDANCE; Houthi directives are threats, not recognized authority over international shipping

sources.outlet: Saudi Press Agency / Saudi Armed Forces
sources.title: Deputy Chief of General Staff at Manama Dialogue: Maritime Security Is a Shared International Responsibility
sources.source_role: PRIMARY_OFFICIAL_UPDATE; official said coalition has been joined by 14 countries by October/November; does not establish full operational deployment

sources.outlet: Reddit r/geopolitics / Wall Street Journal quoted by user
sources.title: Iran-backed Houthis Take Effective Control of Bab al-Mandeb Chokepoint
sources.source_role: SOCIAL_MEDIA_AMPLIFICATION_OF_WSJ_ATTRIBUTED_CLAIM; title says effective control Bab el-Mandeb; repost/carrier is not independent verification

sources.outlet: Saudi Press Agency / Saudi Ministry of Defense
sources.title: Ministry of Defense Hosts International Meeting on Saudi Initiative to Establish Multinational Maritime Defense Alliance
sources.source_role: PRIMARY_OFFICIAL_JOINT_SUPPORT_DECLARATION; 14 July 30 endorsing states listed (Nigeria included, not Comoros); founding procedures still to be completed

sources.title: JMIC Update 113 to Advisory Note: 01 March – 12 November 2026
sources.source_role: PRIMARY_MARITIME_OPERATIONS_REPORT; 92 Bab el-Mandeb commercial transits Nov 8-11, substantial threat, no independently confirmed stable approach control

sources.title: Saudis plan assault on Houthis to break Red Sea chokehold
sources.source_role: REUTERS_SYNDICATED_REPORT; U.S. intelligence and European/regional mainly defensive support confirmed as contemporaneous context; not demonstrated specific strike causation

sources.title: Yemeni government forces seize strategic strait from Houthis
sources.source_role: REUTERS_MULTISOURCE_COASTAL_COUNTEROFFENSIVE_REPORT; government said recaptured most September areas, Reuters could not independently verify full extent and Houthis disputed

sources.title: Operational update 20 October – UK military support to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
sources.source_role: PRIMARY_UK_MOD_DEFENSIVE_SUPPORT; RAF Typhoon protective missions, A400M logistics and extension of tanker-refuelling support; explicitly no UK offensive strikes

sources.title: How is Europe helping Saudi Arabia? France begins deploying military means
sources.source_role: REPORT_OF_EUROPEAN_DEFENSIVE_SUPPORT; France began military deployment, UK/Italy offers; no specific battlefield causation established

sources.outlet: Institute for the Study of War / Critical Threats Project
sources.title: Iran Update, September 17, 2026
sources.source_role: INDEPENDENT_SECURITY_ANALYSIS; distinguishes Houthi territorial control from attempted illegal authority over strait shipping

sources.title: Can the Houthis close the Red Sea after seizing the Yemen coast?
sources.source_role: CONTEMPORANEOUS_MEDIA_EXPLAINER; distinguishes claimed coastal gains from question of closing shipping lane
